dialogueTree.text: Greetings, traveler! I catalog every vessel and navigational chart entering Crownport. Lately, the tides have been erratic ever since Master Jeremy disappeared.

Jeremy was our greatest horologist! He built the Great Clocktower in the plaza. He claimed he designed a Tidal Chronometer that could forecast sea surges, but he fled after arguing with the merchant council.
Crownport is the jewel of Aethelgard. Our docks connect to Tidebreak in the west and the mountain mines of Cragwatch in the northeast.
May the calm seas favor your journey.
Keep clear of the cargo cranes! We have three galleons unloading silver and mountain timber today.
Aye! Last night I caught sight of unmarked barrels stamped with a wolf head. They never paid the Admiralty tariff. The tracks came down from the mountain pass!
Head west along the Old King’s Highway past the Crossroads, then take the salt trail south to Tidebreak.
The Tideguard maintains law across the highways. Beware the deep waters south of Azure Coast—ancient ruins lurk beneath the surface.
That infernal clocktower ticks too loudly! Master Jeremy was always eccentric, murmuring about celestial gears before he vanished into the forest.
Welcome to the Gilded Anchor! Warm stew and spiced cider for weary travelers. Have you heard the music Seraphina plays in the square?
Fine highland wool from Cragwatch, medicinal tea from Oakhaven! Best prices in the realm.
Master Jeremy didn’t abandon us! He left a hidden message in the clocktower gears pointing toward the abandoned lodge in the Whispering Weald.
♪ "O the pale frigate sails where the cold breakers weep, while Silas’s dark beacon lies asleep..." ♪ That song came from the old fishers of Tidebreak.
The road west leads through the Whispering Weald. Stay on the paved stones—the northern Deepwood is disorienting.
We pray for all who brave the tides. The sea remembers what the land forgets.
Welcome, friend. I am tending healing brews. The miners up in Cragwatch suffer terribly from smelter smoke, and only the Deepwood Moonflower can cure them.

choices.text: Where can I find the Moonflower?

dialogueTree.text: It blooms only under the full starlight in the ancient stone circle north of the Whispering Weald. Be careful of the thick forest fog!
Oakhaven is our sanctuary. The roots of the Great Oak run deep into the bedrock, providing sweet freshwater to all.
Long before Crownport existed, King Brandor ruled these shores. The twin standing stones northeast of our village mark where his signet was safeguarded.
The Weald is peaceful if you respect the trees. But watch for the waterfall grotto along the river—the water masks secret openings.
I abandoned my old lodge to the northeast weeks ago. Some fellow in an indigo apron was hiding in the floorboards with brass gears.
Rest your feet by the hearth! Have a bowl of wild mushroom broth before you venture down to the coast.
Tanning buckskin requires steady hands. Don’t toss your coins down the dry well east of here—nobody has ever heard them hit bottom.
The trees whisper when the moon is high! Follow the blue spores to find the fairy ring.
You stand at Old King’s Crossroads! East leads to Crownport, West to Oakhaven, South to Tidebreak, and North across the bridge to the Dragon’s Spine.
Listen closely, young traveler... The Pale Leviathan didn’t founder on the reef by accident forty winters ago. The lighthouse beacon went pitch black!

choices.text: Why did the lighthouse go dark?

dialogueTree.text: Ask Keeper Silas up in the tower! He was on duty that night, and his eyes have held the shadow of guilt ever since.
Its bleached timbers lie in Sorrow Cove along the eastern sandbars. Some nights you can still hear the ship bell ringing.
The wind howls through the crystal prisms... If you seek the truth of that cursed winter night, check the journal behind the lantern glass.
Best clam chowder on the coast! Just don’t ask where the silver in the tip jar came from.
At low tide, you can walk the stepping stones south to a secluded sandbar shrine! The water is crystal clear.
Salt air rots oak faster than you’d believe. If Crownport keeps hiking timber tariffs, we’ll be rowing driftwood.
I weave blessings into the fishing nets so the sea spirits bring our mariners safely home.
Looking for rare goods? Follow the low-tide cliffs east toward the sea arches... if you know how to pick a lock, that is.
*Cough*... The silver vein in the Echoing Chasm is rich, but the smelter fumes are taking our breath. We sent word to Healer Maeve in Oakhaven for her panacea.

choices.text: I am helping Maeve find the Moonflower.

dialogueTree.text: Bless you, traveler! If you bring the elixir to our infirmary, the High Peak Guild will never forget your kindness.
We supply the finest forged steel and lodestones in the realm. The suspension bridge across the gorge leads down toward Crownport.
Lodestone alloy doesn’t bend or rust! Crownport’s knights pay a fortune for our breastplates.
The inscriptions at the peak overlook tell of King Brandor’s royal tomb beneath Azure Coast. Only his sapphire signet can break the ancient vault wards.
The Echoing Chasm portal is straight ahead. Strange resonance hums in the crystals when night falls.
Come inside where it’s warm! Roasted highland lamb and hot spiced mead will melt the frost from your boots.
Watch your step on Dragon’s Spine Pass. The wind howls fiercely through the gorge, but the bridge ropes are freshly greased.
From this overlook you can see across all Aethelgard! On clear nights, the submerged arches of Azure Coast shine like sapphire stars.

properties.name: The Great Clocktower
properties.description: The towering four-faced clocktower overlooking Crownport Plaza.
properties.examineText: The massive brass gears tick in a rhythmic cadence. Etched into the main escapement wheel is a small inscription left by Master Jeremy.

properties.name: Abandoned Woodcutter Lodge
properties.description: A decaying timber cabin with broken roof slats and overgrown ivy.
properties.examineText: Dust dances in the shafts of sunlight. Beneath a loose pine floorboard rests an intricate brass cipher plate.

properties.name: Sunken Clockwork Grotto
properties.description: A damp sea cave echoing with the tick of submerged mechanisms.
properties.examineText: An iron chest sits on a dry stone plinth. Fitting the brass cipher plate into the lock reveals the golden Tidal Chronometer!

properties.name: Old Salty's Tavern
properties.description: A smoke-filled seaside tavern where aged mariners exchange ghost stories.
properties.examineText: A carved whale tooth on the wall depicts the Pale Leviathan frigate sailing into dense fog.

properties.name: The Ancient Beacon
properties.description: The monumental stone lighthouse that has warned ships away from the razor reefs for centuries.
properties.examineText: The giant crystal lens glimmers in the sky. Behind the lens frame is a secret cubby with Keeper Silas’s remorseful journal.

properties.name: Sorrow Cove Shipwreck
properties.description: The barnacle-encrusted ribs of a majestic frigate jutting out of the white surf.
properties.examineText: Among the bleached timbers lies Captain Arthur’s brass compass, humming faintly with trapped memories.

properties.name: Admiralty Wharf
properties.description: The deep-water stone quays where merchant galleons unload exotic cargoes.
properties.examineText: A stack of heavy oak barrels bears a carved wolf-head sigil. The wood smells faintly of high mountain smelter pine.

properties.name: Dragon's Spine Cache
properties.description: A sheltered nook beneath an overhanging granite boulder along the high pass.
properties.examineText: Hidden under a flat slate slab is an oilskin ledger documenting clandestine silver shipments to the coast.

properties.name: Smuggler's Cove Cache
properties.description: A sea-level grotto stacked high with contraband crates and refined silver ingots.
properties.examineText: The crates are marked with the wolf sigil. You uncover the iron stamp used to forge the Crownport tax seal!

properties.name: Maeve's Apothecary
properties.description: A fragrant timber cottage surrounded by beds of lavender, sage, and rare moss.
properties.examineText: Drying herbs hang from the rafters. Maeve’s treatise on the table details the medicinal virtues of the Deepwood Moonflower.

properties.name: The Moonlit Fairy Ring
properties.description: A circle of glowing blue mushrooms and ancient standing stones in the heart of Deepwood.
properties.examineText: In the center of the ring blooms the rare Luminescent Moonflower, emitting a gentle azure luminescence.

properties.name: Miner's Rest Infirmary
properties.description: A warm stone shelter where ailing miners rest by the hearth.
properties.examineText: The miners cough softly from the smelter smoke. A fresh pot of boiling mountain water awaits herbal medicine.

properties.name: Mistfall Peak Shrine
properties.description: An ancient granite shrine looking out over the clouds of the continent.
properties.examineText: The ancient stone tablet records the lineage of King Brandor and his burial in the Whispering Weald.

properties.name: Twin Monoliths of Brandor
properties.description: Two towering moss-covered monoliths standing silent sentinel in the forest.
properties.examineText: Between the deep roots of the monoliths rests a stone urn containing King Brandor’s Sapphire Signet.

properties.name: Royal Crypt of King Brandor
properties.description: A half-submerged cyclopean stone doorway leading into the royal catacombs.
properties.examineText: A massive seal in the center of the vault doors matches the shape of King Brandor’s signet ring.

properties.name: The Whispering Dry Well
properties.description: An ancient stone well far off the beaten road. Faint breezes murmur from its depths.
properties.examineText: Dropping a small stone produces no sound. You hear the distant echo of a subterranean ocean tide.

properties.name: Elderwood Altar of the Weald
properties.description: A living altar carved from petrified wood and ancient vine tendrils.
properties.examineText: The air here smells of pine needle and elder honey. The ancient forest spirits watch quietly.

regions.name: Crownport
regions.subtitle: The Gilded Haven of the Grand Bay
regions.loreSummary: The commercial heartbeat of Aethelgard. Crownport is renowned for its cobblestone esplanades, bustling markets, clocktower square, and the fortified Admiralty of the Tideguard.

regions.name: Oakhaven & The Whispering Weald
regions.subtitle: The Emerald Heart of the Old Timber
regions.loreSummary: A tranquil timber-built sanctuary nestled among colossal oak trees. Its herbalists and rangers revere the silence of the woods and protect ancient stone shrines.

regions.name: Tidebreak Village & The Low Shoals
regions.subtitle: Where Salt Winds Greet the Horizon
regions.loreSummary: A rustic coastal settlement perched atop rocky breakers and wooden piers. Home to seasoned mariners, dried fish smokehouses, and the ancient Beacon of Tidebreak.

regions.name: Cragwatch & Mistfall Peaks
regions.subtitle: The Slate Fortress of the High Winds
regions.loreSummary: Carved into the sheer granite face of Mistfall Peaks. Its smoke-plumed smelters refine luminous silver ore and lodestones unearthed from deep cavern veins.

regions.name: The Deepwood Gloom
regions.subtitle: The Shrouded Canopy of the Forgotten
regions.loreSummary: A primeval wilderness where sunlight barely pierces the emerald canopy. Legends speak of a secluded witch's apothecary and the slumbering Elderwood Shrine.

regions.name: The Azure Coast & Sunken Shoals
regions.subtitle: Sunken Arches and Smuggler Coves
regions.loreSummary: A windswept coastline of pristine sandbars, tidal sea arches, and drowned ruins left behind by the Great Eclipse Tide.

settlements.name: Crownport
settlements.loreSummary: Constructed from pale granite and dark slate, Crownport is the jewel of the eastern sea.

settlements.name: Oakhaven
settlements.loreSummary: A cozy village built around a five-century-old oak whose roots feed the central freshwater well.

settlements.name: Tidebreak
settlements.loreSummary: Its stilt-built docks groan with the ocean tides. Mariners here leave coins at the lighthouse to ward off sea sirens.

settlements.name: Cragwatch
settlements.loreSummary: Perched on a razor-thin plateau overlooking the misty valleys below.

secrets.name: Hidden Waterfall Grotto
secrets.hint: Where the river bends sharply east, a curtain of mist conceals a narrow passage behind the boulders.
secrets.visualCue: Cascading river foam and a slight opening between two mossy rocks.
secrets.rewardDescription: An ancient iron chest containing 150 Golden Florins and a Weald Warden Cloak.

secrets.name: Secluded Sandbar Shrine
secrets.hint: A string of low-tide rocks south of Tidebreak leads to a solitary white sand island.
secrets.visualCue: Natural stone stepping stones piercing the turquoise shallows.
secrets.rewardDescription: A glowing Pearl of the Deep Tide that repels sea mist.

secrets.name: Smuggler's Sea Cavern
secrets.hint: Behind the twin sea arches lies a hidden dry cavern above high-water mark.
secrets.visualCue: A narrow gap in the dark cliff wall marked by an anchor carving.
secrets.rewardDescription: Contraband silver bars and the illicit merchant ledger.

secrets.name: Abandoned Silver Vein Ledge
secrets.hint: Follow the broken rail cart tracks beyond the high mine portal along the outer cliff.
secrets.visualCue: A weathered wooden plank spanning a narrow rock crevice.
secrets.rewardDescription: Luminous lodestones that glow in the dark.

secrets.name: The Witch’s Hidden Herb Glade
secrets.hint: Dense pine trees form a labyrinth in northwest Deepwood, hiding a peaceful floral clearing.
secrets.visualCue: A carpet of glowing blue mushrooms guiding through the tree trunks.
secrets.rewardDescription: A vial of Elixir of Swiftness (+30% move speed).

secrets.name: Jeremy’s Tidal Workshop
secrets.hint: A secret lock in the coastal rock face operated by a brass gear.
secrets.visualCue: A brass plate embedded in the limestone.

secrets.name: High Peak Eagle Roost
secrets.hint: A dizzying mountain spire overlooking the entire eastern bay.
secrets.visualCue: An iron piton driven into the stone at the path edge.
secrets.rewardDescription: A Spyglass of the High Winds revealing the full world map.

secrets.name: Tomb of the First Admiral
secrets.hint: Submerged marble columns near the reef at low tide.
secrets.visualCue: Pale carved marble slabs beneath clear coastal water.
secrets.rewardDescription: The Ceremonial Rapier of the Tideguard.

secrets.name: The Whispering Hollow
secrets.hint: A colossal hollow oak tree north of Oakhaven with a hidden interior chamber.
secrets.visualCue: A wide knot in the ancient bark emitting warm amber light.

secrets.name: Silas’s Secret Smuggler Cellar
secrets.hint: Beneath the wooden stilt deck of the lighthouse lies a hidden trapdoor.
secrets.visualCue: A rusted iron ring attached to a wooden hatch.
secrets.rewardDescription: A cache of aged mariner’s spiced rum and silver coins.
